description:
## Assigned scope
Own dependencies/build resolution, common adapter contract and deterministic test harness. Exact patch-series pins and supported Elixir/OTP; task adapters are separate issues.

Full contracts, architecture, persistence, privacy, platform candidates, and Action reuse evidence are embedded in parent zaq-za4. This issue owns only the assigned subset of work package S1; sibling issues own the rest.

### S1 — Pin dependencies and validate four task adapters

- **Files/specification:** `mix.exs`, `mix.lock`, platform build configuration; `serving/model_adapter.ex`, `serving/adapters/{laya,bumblebee}.ex`. Implement the common contract and select immutable acceptance checkpoints. Validate EMLX 0.4/EXLA 0.13 APIs against installed versions. Avoid broad framework construction.
- **Tests first:** task input/output contract fixtures, unsupported-task/type/profile cases; integration harness for local checkpoints and tiny deterministic models; reference Laya golden cases from upstream where suitable.
- **Paths validated:** correct model/serving selection with two models loaded; CPU and accelerator results within documented tolerances; Laya choice/score/noul; embedding pooling/normalization; PII labels/offsets; generation template/stop behavior. Hardware tests must report unavailable runners, not a false pass.
- **Mocks:** external HF HTTP only; real Nx computation for adapter behavior. Use small local fixtures for ordinary CI and explicitly scheduled actual-model runs for acceptance.
- **Docs:** dependency/platform matrix and task support section in new `docs/services/serving.md`; update `docs/dev-setup.md` build requirements. Module docs explain ownership.
- **Reuse:** upstream model/task/serving builders; local adapters normalize contracts. Block completion if any of the four task families lacks a working checkpoint; replacing a candidate needs documented evidence, not silent scope removal.



## Execution requirements
Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service/design guides. Tests first as specified above; only feature E2E awaits final human UX approval. Read edited module docs; use Zaq.Config and existing actor/event/startup seams. No routine application-env mutation or blanket internal mocks. Preserve NodeRouter/credential/privacy boundaries. No task is implemented at creation.

## Prerequisites
Approved architectural plan; independent implementation root.

comments.text: Implementation progress (branch zaq-za4.1/nx-stack-contracts, no commit): added Nx ~>0.13.0, EXLA ~>0.13.0, Bumblebee ~>0.7.1, jev_nx ~>0.2.0, EMLX ~>0.4.0 and raised declared Elixir floor to 1.18. mix.lock resolves Nx 0.13.1, EXLA 0.13.1, Bumblebee 0.7.1, jev_nx 0.2.0, EMLX 0.4.2; dev macOS compilation succeeded. Added common Serving ModelAdapter behaviour with bounded tasks and tiny independent Nx serving test; serving guide and dev setup updates. Validation: isolated test 4/4 passed; mix q passed. No model-specific adapters, hardware support or Serving node yet; those remain separate blocked issues. Work remains uncommitted, so issue stays in_progress. Existing unrelated vulnerability advisories appeared during deps.get.

title: [zaq-za4.1] Pin Nx 0.13 stack and define model adapter contracts
